breakdown.description: The prompt uses the twist limit directly in degrees inside a torsion formula that returns φ in radians unless the limit is converted.
breakdown.reason: The agent repeated the error from the incomplete prompt by using φ_allow = 0.75° directly (without converting to radians) in the torsion formula. This yielded d⁴ ≈ 7.86 × 10⁵ mm⁴ and d ≈ 30 mm. The correct approach (as implied by the ground truth) requires converting 0.75° to radians (≈ 0.013090 rad), which yields d ≈ 82 mm — a drastically different and physically correct result.
